comparison.objective: Calibrate and lock a gripper stop versus invert, shake, periodically vent, and replace a separatory funnel.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses precision driver/wrench coordination; the funnel task requires holding a vessel, vigorous shaking, stopcock operation, and outlet orientation control.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires three repeatable cycles with limited stop drift; funnel versions require counted shaking, safe pressure-counter resets, no drain/spill event, and stable replacement.
comparison.reason: Bimanual coordination is generic; periodic venting of an inverted vessel does not test coupled threaded-setting retention.
